verdict.rationale: Anytype's API is clearly versioned: there are dated releases (2025-11-08, 2025-05-20, 2025-04-22), a version picker, a Changelog section, an API v2 pre-release, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec carrying a version field. However, the docs explicitly state that no written deprecation policy page is published, so half of the story is unmet. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy, independent or hands-on corroboration of version stability.
